_note: Tag Teams section (assets/teams.js). The teams themselves are built in the app from the Goddess of Stardom and NEW BLOOD Tag Team title histories (assets/lineage/goddess.json and newblood.json, or the daily file's copies), so a new champion team appears without editing this file. This file only adds what the histories don't say. eraStarts = the first day of eras 2 to 5 (era 1 is everything before); a team's era is the era of its first title win. factionNames = team names in the histories that are really a faction's name: such pairs are shown as their two names with the faction underneath. spell = the spelling the site uses in its video titles and search, where it differs from the title histories; the history spelling is searched too, as a second search. extra = teams that never held these titles: {name, members: [a, b], since: 'YYYY-MM-DD', faction}.
